verdict.rationale: Alma publishes guides on publicly accessible URLs covering founder visas. These include an O-1A startup-founders guide with self-sponsorship and agent-petitioner mechanics, an International Entrepreneur Rule explainer with dated fee changes, a founder visa-options page, and visa guides on eligibility, process and required evidence. That covers the criteria breakdowns and process explainers. Missing for 10: real case examples, explicit evidence that the guides are ungated and not lead capture (pages carry strong service and consultation CTAs), and independent corroboration of guide depth.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait
